name: Flight Master's Whistle offers the three nearest flight masters and retreats after a 10 second cast (#8204, #9460)
contract: Live Ascension's Flight Master's Whistle (item 10, spell 158) opens a choice: 'Choose between the 3 closest
Flightmasters below to teleport to that location.' Choosing one starts a 10 second cast of spell 2485
(CastingTimeIndex 7), and the 30 minute cooldown (category 101) starts only after that retreat completes. From
Goldshire (map 0, -9561.2 9.5 59.1) the three closest served Alliance taxi nodes are Stormwind (2, 867 yards),
Sentinel Hill (4, 1482 yards, -10629.3 1036.9 34.0) and Darkshire (12, 1590 yards). Choosing the second option
lands the player at Sentinel Hill.

steps.label: The whistle offers exactly three flight masters
Opening the choice does not start the cooldown
Opening the choice does not move the player
The player is still in Goldshire during the cast
The retreat lands at Sentinel Hill
The whistle is on its 30 minute cooldown after the retreat
